question: The cubes of side lengths 15 cm, and 9 cm are melted as cast into two cubes in such a way that no metal is wasted. If the side length of the first cube is 16 cm then find the side length of the second cube. (in cm)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Volume of old cubes = Total Volume of new cubes

15³ + 9³ = 16³ + x³

3375 + 729 = 4096 + x³

4104 − 4096 = x³ ⇒ x³ = 8

x = √³8 = 2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 2 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Side of **first old cube** (a₁) = 15 cm, Side of **second old cube** (a₂) = 9 cm. Side of **first new cube** (s₁) = 16 cm.

**Formula Used:** Volume of a cube = (side)³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a920df2d6517b94a21bc0116848746ad51236fb44fd6067e8d0c66ffdb7a7074.png] 

⇒ Volume of **Old Cubes** = 15³ + 9³

⇒ Volume of **Old Cubes** = 3375 + 729 = 4104 cm³

⇒ Volume of **New Cubes** = 16³ + x³

⇒ 4104 = 4096 + x³

⇒ x³ = 4104 − 4096

⇒ x³ = 8

⇒ x = 2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 2 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Invariance

When a solid is **melted** and recast into other shapes without wastage, the **total volume** remains constant.

Cube Properties

Total Surface Area of a cube = 6a² and Lateral Surface Area = 4a², where 'a' is the side length.

Diagonal of a Cube

The longest rod that can be placed inside a cube is its diagonal, given by d = a√3.</p
